scenario: the first practical exchange about airports & flights
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Airports and Flights
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: airports & flights — the first practical exchange about airports & flights
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about airports & flights; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Ms Grace which gate her flight is at.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi chị Grace chuyến bay của mình ở cổng nào.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Grace. Which gate is my flight?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Grace. Chuyến bay của tôi ở cổng nào vậy?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Cổng mười hai à. Cảm ơn chị.
